hypothesis: Retrospective provider preclose changes can locate coverage or convention gaps; they do not prove economic-event completeness or Alpha.
scope: original six stocks and sealed dates only
comparison_order: require original close and full dates equality before reference audit
compare each preclose with previous frozen raw close; first day unknown
report every changed reference and every supplied cash event date
cash exact expectation = previous frozen raw close minus declared price_adjustment_per_share
auxiliary cent reference uses positive half-up; report both, never fit tolerance
numeric_policy: Exact rational decimal comparison; no tolerance, no rounding inputs; mark non-cent references
failure_policy: Invalid binding/clock/protocol/rows or close mismatch refuses reference conclusions; retain failure. Unknown changes stay unknown; never auto-create facts.
